title: ANDOVIA
tickerText: Andovia is an alternative rock band rooted between the Atlanta and Athens areas. Andovia creates their genre from blending grunge, alternative metal, rock, and shoegaze. Andovia is comprised of Brendan Page on vocals and guitar, Cole Chandler on drums, Chet Guntharp on bass and John Rucks on guitar.
